title: Kids & the career equation — Priya, 34, back from leave
caption:
Pay drops ~20% after the first baby. Men's doesn't (Kleven, AEJ 2019).
Ask for your scope in writing before leave. Then hand off one whole task at home (Fair Play).
Send this to her. Who owns the school forms?
www.aiforheratx.org
#motherhoodpenalty #workingmom #womenshealth #maternityleave #momlife

scenes.text: Nobody said no. They just gave the migration project to someone else.
phrases: We didn't want to overload you.
Figured you'd want something lighter for now.

scenes.text: It wasn't that she got worse at her job. Her hours and her projects moved.
phrases: She checked her old reviews. Still "exceeds".
What changed was the pickup at 5, every day.
So she stopped arguing at work first, and started at home.

scenes.text: Hand over one whole task at home tonight — noticing it, planning it, doing it.
phrases: Pick one: school forms, groceries, the dentist.
Give away all three parts, not just the doing.
Then take the 10-minute walk you keep skipping (WHO: 150 min/week).
